issue.title: Athena root daily, weekly, and monthly cron still execute bryan-writable scripts

task_type_fields.impact: A compromise of the bryan account still becomes root daily, weekly, or monthly through cron without a sudo prompt, so bob-cli-96's hourly fix leaves the privilege boundary open. Medium-high severity on a host that was breached on 2026-10-17.
task_type_fields.repro:
On athena as bryan (no root needed), 2026-10-23:

```bash
find /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly -maxdepth 1 -type l -printf '%p -> %l\n'
stat -Lc '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/cron.daily/daily_jobs /etc/cron.daily/daily_backup /etc/cron.weekly/weekly_jobs /etc/cron.weekly/weekly_backup /etc/cron.monthly/monthly_backup
```

`daily_jobs`, `daily_backup`, `weekly_jobs`, `weekly_backup`, and `monthly_backup` are root cron entries. Each is a symlink into `/home/bryan/db/bin/cron.jobs/cron.{daily,weekly,monthly}/`, and the backup entries source Bryan's own `backup.sh`. This is the same writable-chain shape that bob-cli-96 removed from `/etc/cron.hourly` (phase bob-cli-an.2).

Fix: reuse the tailnet `hosts/athena/root-cron/` pattern. Install regular root-owned entrypoints that pin `PATH` and source reviewed copies under `/usr/local/lib/athena-cron/`. Extend `install_root_cron.py` and `verify_root_cron.py` to cover these entrypoints, with baseline guards, rollback, and bryan/nobody denial probes. Apply through a reviewed `/sase_sudo` gate. Proposed by bob-cli-an.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3). Size medium: the hourly migration already proved the installer, verifier, and exercise pattern.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-an.2 hardened only the two hourly root cron chains (bob-cli-96 scope); the lander confirmed five daily/weekly/monthly root entries still resolve into Bryan's writable tree.

payload.description: Same writable root-cron chain defect; bob-cli-96 (phase bob-cli-an.2) fixed only the hourly entries and provides the tailnet installer/verifier pattern to extend
daily/weekly/monthly backups share backup.sh rotation logic whose rsync exit-24 discard bob-cli-1a tracks; coordinate edits to the root-owned copy
Lander recheck of task scope before closing for bob-cli-an.6

payload.entry: Verified by bob-cli-an.6 lander 2026-10-23: /etc/cron.{daily,weekly,monthly} entrypoints are root-owned regular files from tailnet 642c4fe+1055f2f (backup tiers pin PATH and source root-owned /usr/local/lib/athena-cron/backup.sh; jobs tiers are drop-only sudo -u bryan wrappers). Gate sudo-2ef446df: 132/132 root checks, 11 boundary regressions, and bryan/nobody denial probes all passed. Lander rerun of verify_root_cron.py as bryan: 105/105 pass, all installed payloads byte-identical to source, every bryan create/write denial denied, run-parts lists all 7 entries across 4 tiers. Rollback is documented and tested (install_root_cron.py --rollback).
